extension.title: Asset Manage
extension.description: Sidebar and preview for images, fonts, media and documents.
extension.scanIncludeDesc: Glob patterns for files to include in asset scanning.
extension.scanExcludeDesc: Glob patterns for files to exclude from asset scanning.
extension.workspaceRequired: Asset Manage: Please open a workspace first.
extension.semanticSearchCommand: Asset Manage: Search Images by Description
extension.buildImageIndexCommand: Asset Manage: Rebuild Image Search Index
extension.ss.ocrEnabledDesc: Use OCR text to assist image search ranking (downloads OCR language packs on first use).
extension.ss.ocrWeightDesc: Weight of the OCR score in the final ranking (0-1).
extension.ss.topNDesc: Maximum number of search results to return.
extension.ss.minScoreDesc: Minimum score for a result to be shown (0-1).
extension.ss.concurrencyDesc: Maximum number of images indexed concurrently.
extension.ss.modelCachePathDesc: Override the model cache directory. Empty uses the extension's global storage.
extension.ss.mirrorsDesc: Model download hosts tried in order (e.g. huggingface.co then hf-mirror.com).
